expectedUsable: The purely decorative divider is hidden from assistive tech (empty alt), so a screen-reader user isn't read a long, meaningless description mid-essay.

violations.expectedFix: Set alt="" (and optionally role="presentation") so the decorative flourish is skipped by screen readers; it conveys no information.
violations.notes: The image is decorative but carries a long alt string, so axe's image-alt rule passes. This is the inverse of an empty-alt error: the fix is to REMOVE the alt content, not add more. Layer C flags the verbose alt on a ground-truth-decorative image as SR noise.
